children: Our Bureau Bengaluru: JSW One Platforms has filed its draft red herring prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) for an initial public offering of up to 3,054 crore, comprising a fresh issue of 1,300 crore and an offer for sale of up to 1,754 crore.
JSW Steel will sell shares worth up to 811 crore, JSW Cement up to 123 crore and existing investor Mitsui & Co up to 820.01 crore, according to the filing.

Of the fresh equity, the company plans to invest 500 crore in its non-banking financial company JSW One Finance, 350 crore on technology and platform development and 125 crore in marketing and brand-building through subsidiary JSW One Distribution. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

JSW One may also raise up to 260 crore through a pre-IPO placement, which would reduce the fresh issue by an equivalent amount, the company said. The company's revenue from operations rose 45% to 5,743.4 crore in FY26 from 3,962.8 crore a year earlier, while its net loss narrowed to 106.5 crore from 217 crore.

Its gross merchandise value increased 48% to 18,596.9 crore. JSW One turned profitable in the quarter ended June, reporting a net profit of 14.2 crore on revenue of 1,642.5 crore. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) stood at 22.9 crore. The filing highlighted the company's dependence on the JSW Group.

Materials and services sourced from group entities accounted for 85.7% of net merchandise value in FY26, while related parties made up 63.5% of stock-in-trade purchases. ET first reported on September 17 that JSW One was preparing to file for a 3,000-crore-plus IPO and was targeting a listing in April-June 2027.
JM Financial, Kotak Mahindra Capital, ICICI Securities, SBI Capital Markets and PL Capital Markets are the book-running lead managers for the issue.

JSW One operates a technology platform connecting businesses buying manufacturing and construction materials with suppliers, lenders, logistics providers and material processors. It also operates private brands and JSW One Homes, its home-construction business, which was strengthened through the acquisition of BuildNext in June. Valued at $1 billion in May 2025, JSW One competes with Infra.Market, OfBusiness and Zetwerk-owned Terra91, all of which are pursuing public-market routes. Zetwerk has filed updated papers, Infra.Market is taking the reverse-merger route with Shalimar Paints, while OfBusiness has revived its IPO plans.

title: JSW One Files Papers with Sebi for 3,054-crore IPO
